notes:
Lead: Jordan Myers. Product interest: RAG for customer support with strict latency SLOs (P95 <= 120ms) and top-5 quality for reranking. They ingest historical tickets + KB (approx 50M docs; avg doc length 120 tokens). Key ask: end-to-end cost per query target < $0.002 (embeddings + ANN + cross-encoder rerank amortized).

POC constraints: must run inside customer VPC or dedicated Redwood pool; SOC2 + KMS; no raw ticket data to third-party vectors outside VPC. Security team asked for KMS flow diagram and audit log retention policy (30d primary, archive 365d).

Engineering notes from discovery call: prefer hybrid retrieval — BM25 prefilter (~2-3k hits) -> ANN dense vectors (512-d embeddings) -> GPU cross-encoder rerank top-20 -> return top-5. Want support for async streaming for agent UI; requires first-pass quick hits < 70ms for top-3 and full rerank P95 < 120ms.

Quoted on call: "We need deterministic SLOs — if reranker adds tail latency, we need automatic fallback to a lightweight reranker or cached results." SE asked about Redwood's prefix/KV caching and dynamic model routing. JD: high cost sensitivity; predicted 500k queries/day at launch.

Current stance: evaluation — agreed to 4-week POC: indexing + rerank on Dedicated GPUs, end-to-end SLAs measured with their synthetic workload. Simone to send POC spec and test harness. Rafael will scope onboarding and SSO provisioning.

Misc: early concern about quantization impact on ranking signal; want example evals vs. full-precision cross-encoder. Also asked for a pricing scenario: dedicated reserved baseline + incremental per-token rerank GPU cost.
